1	Elysian Speakers: Turning Your Home into a Sonic Heaven
     2	
     3	The culmination of a special three-year R&D project, Wharfedale’s new flagship speakers are the
     4	ultimate expression of pure musical enjoyment embedded at the heart of this famous British brand.
     5	
     6	Cambridgeshire, England – In Greek mythology, the Elysian Fields are a heavenly place where the
     7	heroic and the virtuous are rewarded in the afterlife. Elysian, as an adjective, means blissful – a
     8	fitting name for Wharfedale’s new flagship loudspeakers, conceived to deliver blissful sonic reward
     9	to music lovers seeking heavenly respite from the rigours of daily life.
    10	
    11	Two Elysian loudspeakers have been created; a large standmount model called Elysian 2 (£4,500 per
    12	pair) and a floorstanding speaker named Elysian 4 (£6,500 per pair). Both speakers were developed
    13	concurrently with the EVO4 Series, which launched towards the end of 2019 and sits immediately below
    14	Elysian in Wharfedale’s new hierarchy.
    15	
    16	Elysian and EVO4 share many design elements, having benefitted from the same R&D process as part of
    17	a unified project. The core speakers in both ranges are three-way designs, sporting an unusual and
    18	sophisticated driver array including an Air Motion Transformer (AMT) high-frequency unit. But with
    19	Elysian, each component part is engineered to the very highest standard. The drivers, the crossover,
    20	the cabinet – every aspect has been developed in harmony and without cost constraint to push the
    21	project to its performance limit. Many of these elements were trickled down, remodelled and
    22	engineered in a more affordable form to create the EVO4 Series, enabling the speakers in this range
    23	to deliver astounding value for money.
    24	
    25	With the EVO4 Series already winning major awards, now is the time for Wharfedale to unleash
    26	Elysian.
    27	
    28	Elysian AMT Treble Unit
    29	
    30	In the 1940s, Wharfedale’s founder, Gilbert Briggs, developed the first two-way speaker for domestic
    31	use, radical for its separate treble and bass drivers combined via a crossover. Early treble units,
    32	such as Brigg’s famous Super 3, resembled small cones as the necessity for reproducing high
    33	frequencies demanded the use of low-mass diaphragms. It was subsequently realized that the dome in
    34	the centre of the cone was doing most of the work and this gave rise to the now ubiquitous dome
    35	tweeter.
    36	
    37	Dome treble units have dominated the hi-fi scene for decades, but they are not necessarily the ideal
    38	way of reproducing the exact harmonics of the musical waveform. In order to reduce moving mass, the
    39	dome has to be small and use ultra-thin materials, both of which counteract its efficiency and
    40	accuracy.
    41	
    42	The AMT is a radically different way of moving air, using a large, pleated, lightweight diaphragm
    43	driven across its surface by rows of strategically placed metallic strips immersed in a strong
    44	magnetic field. The pleats in the diaphragm contract and expand under the influence of the musical
    45	drive, squeezing the air between them to form the desired waveform.
    46	
    47	Not only is this an efficient way of moving air, it is also highly accurate as the diaphragm is
    48	under close control of the motor system at all times. The result is a wide bandwidth transducer that
    49	achieves extremely low distortion and wonderful musical detail, with scintillating speed and dynamic
    50	ability.
    51	
    52	The development of this AMT unit was a key part of the Elysian/EVO4 project. The Elysian AMT is
    53	larger and of higher specification than the one used in the EVO4 Series, featuring an
    54	ultra-lightweight diaphragm material called PET and an acoustically damped rear chamber, delivering
    55	even more spellbindingly clear and sweetly extended high frequencies.
    56	
    57	Elysian Midrange Driver
    58	
    59	In the spirit of Gilbert Briggs, who was well known for experimenting with new driver materials,
    60	Wharfedale investigated a range of options to match the sensitivity and accuracy of the AMT treble
    61	unit.
    62	
    63	The company settled on a proprietary woven glass fibre matrix, formed into a 150mm cone. This
    64	provides a superb combination of low mass and high strength, with the addition of a high-plasticity
    65	coating to control its acoustic behaviour. With such a low-mass cone, only a low-damping, foamed,
    66	rubber-like material would match for the surround – again, coated for durability.
    67	
    68	A central phase plug is specially shaped to linearise the output across a wide bandwidth, even
    69	off-axis, enhancing a natural response to the music that can be heard anywhere the listener wishes
    70	to sit.
    71	
    72	This midrange driver enables the Elysian speakers to deliver voices and instruments with astonishing
    73	realism. Vocalists seem to be present in the room with the listener – simply close your eyes and
    74	listen to the palpable presence of singers in the acoustic space.
    75	
    76	Elysian Bass Driver
    77	
    78	The midrange unit is matched with a glass fibre matrix cone for the bass unit, in this case
    79	terminated with a highly flexible rubber surround and driven by a specially developed low-distortion
    80	motor system.
    81	
    82	In order to plumb the depths of the lowest frequencies in recorded music, the 220mm bass units – one
    83	in the Elysian 2, two in the Elysian 4 – are capable of reaching down below 28Hz in-room, revealing
    84	the full body and impact of percussion, stringed and wind instruments.
    85	
    86	The bass units are loaded by an advanced version of Wharfedale’s signature slot-loaded port.
    87	Christened SLPP (Slot-Loaded Profiled Port), it ensures that the rear output of the bass units is
    88	not wasted. Instead, the lowest frequency energy is vented to a slot at the base of the speaker,
    89	specially profiled to equalise the high internal pressure to the low pressure in the room.
    90	
    91	This reduces the distortion that is typical of bass reflex systems and increases the port’s
    92	efficiency. In addition, because the air is dispersed uniformly in the room, the speakers are less
    93	fussy about siting.
    94	
    95	Elysian Crossover Network
    96	
    97	The drivers’ output is combined via a sophisticated crossover network, fine-tuned over hundreds of
    98	hours of listening tests to ensure a seamless blend between the drive units.
    99	
   100	Of particular note is the phase consistency across the driver output, permitting a wide range of
   101	seating positions and encouraging the power response to be highly linear throughout the listening
   102	room. Only the highest grade, acoustically transparent components are used throughout the crossover
   103	network, ensuring all the musical detail is heard with nothing held back.
   104	
   105	Elysian Cabinet
   106	
   107	The Elysian speaker cabinets are designed to enhance the acoustic output of the drivers and provide
   108	a piece of furniture of which the owner can be justly proud. Handcrafted veneers are enhanced by
   109	true piano finish lacquers, hand-polished to six levels of depth to give a truly beautiful finish.
   110	
   111	Beneath the veneer is a sandwich of woods of differing density, designed to reduce panel resonance
   112	to below audibility. Named PROS (Panel Resonance Optimization System), this multi-layer construction
   113	also inhibits the leakage of unwanted sound energy from inside the cabinet, which would otherwise
   114	interfere with the forward output of the drive units.
   115
